next_step_summary: PR #232 is an explicitly product-owner-authorized bounded research exception prompted by impractically long Google Batch T4 provisioning and the high CPU cost of full-page Surya transcription. It adds a targeted-region benchmark that accepts bounded caller-supplied regions in stable post-EXIF page coordinates, crops only those regions, batches them through one Surya RecognitionPredictor call, and restricts SURYA_INFERENCE_PARALLEL to 1, 2, or 4. Persistent output is aggregate-only; raw crop pixels and raw OCR text remain transient. The PR does not yet implement candidate-region detection, Tesseract integration, production PII decisions/masks, Cloud Run runtime changes, Android upload, Gemini/legal analysis, storage, or provider authorization. active_track and next_step_id remain unchanged until runtime evidence justifies a separate product-direction change.
